crossRefs.note: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may…
She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember…
Therefore I have also given him to Yahweh. As long as he lives he is given to Yahweh.” He worshiped Yahweh there.

translations.web: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
translations.bsb: What shall I say, O my son? What, O son of my womb? What, O son of my vows?
translations.kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
translations.asv: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?
